einzeiler: A box of cold-case files arrives at a newsroom, reigniting a 1986 poisoning investigation.
kurzfassung: A mysterious suitcase containing decades-old investigation files arrives at a newspaper office, breathing new life into the 1986 cold case of Roslyn McQueen. Roslyn died from strychnine poisoning while pregnant, and a coroner previously named her husband Ray as the murderer, though no trial took place. Journalists interview retired private investigator Rex Bakes and the former teenage babysitter targeted by Ray, uncovering fresh perspectives on the tragedy.
stichpunkte: A heavy suitcase filled with handwritten notes and documents regarding the 1986 death of Roslyn McQueen arrives at a newsroom.
Roslyn McQueen died from strychnine poisoning in Bendigo while five-and-a-half months pregnant and caring for her toddler.
A 1987 coroner's inquest named Roslyn's husband, Ray McQueen, as her murderer, but no murder trial proceeded at the time.
Retired private investigator Rex Bakes spent decades pursuing the case independently after initially working for Ray's defense.
Ray McQueen had become infatuated with a 14-year-old babysitter named Donna, whom he later proposed to in writing after Roslyn's death.
Journalists Headley Thomas and Karina Berger review newly accessed inquest transcripts and interview key figures, including Donna.
Donna reflects on the intense police interrogation she faced as a teenager and expresses her enduring guilt and desire for justice.

Uncovering the Inquest and Donna's Story

clips.text: A legal defense specialist investigates the unsolved 1986 homicide of Rosalind McQueen near Bendigo, convinced the murder was premeditated.

clips.hook: The tragic details of Roslyn's poisoning
clips.text: Ray McQueen left for his job at National Mutual Insurance on April 1, 1986, leaving his pregnant wife Ros and toddler Jodie at their Lockwood home, where Ros ingested a fatal amount of strychnine.

clips.hook: Discovering strychnine in a remote shed
clips.text: An agricultural worker once showed the podcast host a stash of strychnine inside a shed, a location she has repeatedly searched for by car and airplane without success.

clips.hook: Unanswered questions about how the poison was ingested
clips.text: Investigators failed to discover any trace of the poison at the residence, leaving open the question of how the toxic substance entered her system.
A woman recalls how a married man pursued her for a relationship when she was a frightened 16-year-old infatuated with him.

beschreibung:
A cold case murder by strychnine poisoning of a pregnant mother of one is revived when a suitcase filled with documents is sent to the newsroom by a retired private investigator.
Secrets and lies surrounding the death of Rosslyn McQueen in a small rural community four decades ago spill out of the suitcase and trigger a new investigation into this unsolved homicide.
And a vulnerable teenager groomed by a married man more than twice her age breaks her silence.
